PARKEZI WEBSITE PREVIEW — V8

Open index.html for the white homepage, home-v2.html or home-v2-alt.html for black hero variations, express-pay.html for the product page, and style-guide/index.html for the design system. All assets are local except the original Crisp chat script.

V8: searchable country picker with 46 local SVG flags, Australia +61 default; outlined contact/footer phone links with fixed icons and rolling labels; inline field icons; single row of trust marks; four original partner logos; no marketing eyebrow labels or Google badge arrows. The form has six required fields plus optional image/PDF attachments. Parking-type selector and the note beneath the form have been removed.

SolarGate uses separate background, cabinet and rotating barrier layers, with hover and touch controls. Installation/support follows SolarGate and uses a square photo. Software section has a dark surface. Mercure case study has its original logo and four original installation photographs in a locally bundled Swiper gallery supporting desktop drag, touch and keyboard navigation.

Forms and newsletter remain local interaction previews, not a connected lead endpoint. Form submission clearly reports that details have not been sent; there is no fabricated success state. Connect the approved Basin endpoint before launch. Attachments remain local. Crisp uses the original Parkezi workspace and may display its configured greeting.

No customer reviews have been fabricated. Placeholder cards and layout labels have been removed. The original Google profile link and source website's rating badge remain. Supply verified Parkezi five-star review content before populating the retained review carousel. Reviews from Smart Access are not Parkezi reviews and were not substituted.

Product pages outside Express Pay display a scope notice linking to the original product. Source FAQ and comparison content is retained. Site audience remains owner-private; this does not modify parkezi.com.au.

Vendor assets: Swiper 12.0.3 and flag-icons 7.5.0 (MIT; notices in assets/vendor). Original client assets remain their respective owners' property.
